gnosh prompt

  See what the model is sent, and where to change it. These start no session.

  None of these commands is built yet in this build of gnosh: typing one stops
  with a message that says so.

Usage
  gnosh prompt <command> [flags] [arguments]

Commands
  show [name]             Print the instructions in effect, and where they
                          came from. (Not built yet.)
  path                    Print the folder where your own versions of the
                          instructions go. (Not built yet.)
  export [name]           Write the built-in instructions to that folder, as a
                          file to edit. (Not built yet.)
  tools                   Print what the model is told about each tool, with
                          sizes. (Not built yet.)
  context                 Print what fills the context window, by category.
                          (Not built yet.)

Flags
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
